authority: Rust owns model/history/HTML. Loader owns only bounded transient presentation state. No model JSON clone/hash or semantic engine.
normal_ack: Snapshot-specific #112 structural acknowledgment, not a general typed Rust response: known request action plus freshly generated normal #export-json and [data-editor-status].status without .error, consumed only after completed synchronous api.dispatch→paint. Never human status text, old DOM after an exception, or fallback alert.
document_identity: Loader monotonic document epoch advances only after acknowledged successful import or confirm_discard. New initialization starts an empty cache. Distinct documents with identical stable IDs cannot share drafts.
inspector_scope: Selected stable element ID and matching property/control IDs; unknown/mismatched scope refuses restoration. Creation/import controls remain document-scoped.
geometry_scope: Preserve across proven stage/rename/attribute/cancel/recover_preview/select/canvas_cancel paths that keep committed document/current frame. Invalidate on attempted commit/undo/redo and canvas publication/import/history or ambiguity even if a normal .error appears, since inherited post-mutation canvas exhaustion can fail. Failed atomic import/confirmed-discard may preserve only under exact #112 precheck proof. No canvas epoch as document identity.
submitted_forms: Exclude pending submitted edit form from fallback retention; never restore a cancelled huge rename/attribute or re-trigger fallback. Normal refused-form preservation remains separate and must retain its text/caret.
bounds: Explicit field/disclosure counts, UTF8 and UTF16 content plus ID/metadata limits before retention; refuse visibly before losing valid drafts. No silent truncation or overflow replacement.
focus: Only matching cached control id/tag/type and permitted scope can receive caret. Otherwise honor Rust focus request. Stable disclosure IDs/form-action keys, never array position.
scheduler: Synchronous input ownership remains unchanged. Mandatory font invalidation gets a loader-owned callback token and deferred barrier if draft capture refuses. Suppress old canvas compute/apply callbacks immediately; execute real canvas_cancel before later ordinary actions once admission succeeds. Clear the barrier only on fresh normal non-error cancellation or source-proven normal recovery/discard acknowledgment. Exceptions retain suppression/untrusted state.
exceptions: Before-dispatch cap/serialization rejection does not acknowledge/reset a document. After dispatch/paint uncertainty marks cache context untrusted and must prevent stale values crossing an unknown editor; show explicit notice and do not recapture old DOM into a fresh session until fresh output replaces it.
fallback_barrier: Fresh recovery-shell output hides cancellation result. Retain the barrier through ambiguity; allow recovery/keep/confirmed discard safely without repeatedly sending canvas_cancel that would reset the Rust confirmation flag. A fresh successful normal recover/discard proves the exact #112 cancellation path. Do not resume ordinary queued work merely because fallback repainted.
observed_regression: canvas-invalidation-red-01: overquota draft blocked queued compute/font cancel; after shortening and no-history Redo, prior ticket3 requeued and published600bytes with model unchanged. This proves uncancelled/requeued work, not different/wrong geometry coordinates.
selection_payload: The 128-character metadata key cap applies to DOM/form/disclosure keys, not arbitrary valid model element IDs. Retain and aggregate-charge the full exact selected identity only when inspector records require it; no hash/truncation/DOM ref. Document-scoped actions must have an escape after resetting/blur editable drafts, restoring inspector disclosure defaults and choosing Document root parent.
disclosure_defaults: At most32 native inspector disclosure defaults are recorded in a fresh per-paint WeakMap before restoration. Preserve changed/focused inspector disclosure state, including deliberately closed Rust-default-open state; pristine defaults do not force an immutable selection identity into the cache.
